steps.title: Meet Cru
steps.body: The voice assistant is Cru now, said like "crew", and it calls you Sir. It answers to its name: say "Hey Cru" while it is listening and it tells you it is there. The mic in the top bar is Cru's mark now.

steps.title: Cru learns how you like it
steps.body: Tell Cru how to be, or correct it as you go ("shorter", "stop saying that"), and it keeps a note and behaves that way from then on, in every conversation. What it may and may not do stays the same.

steps.title: Cru can see Docker
steps.body: Ask what is running and Cru looks at the containers too: their state, their ports and their logs, and their CPU and memory when you ask about load. It reads Docker only when you ask, and never changes it.

steps.title: Train "Hey Cru" on your voice
steps.body: Before it listens, say "Hey Cru" five times in Settings, Voice assistant. It tunes itself to how you say it and checks each wake against your recordings, so it wakes for you and not for "crew" on the television. On the PC it listens while plugged in.
